summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Stripe integration with real price IDs. All 8 backend tests pass (100%). All 12 frontend tests pass. Checkout creates valid Stripe sessions that redirect to checkout.stripe.com. Webhook correctly rejects invalid signatures. Billing portal correctly blocks free users. Manage Subscription button visibility works correctly (hidden for free, visible for pro/starter).
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/checkout/create-session with plan=starter_monthly returns valid Stripe checkout URL
Backend: POST /api/checkout/create-session with plan=starter_annual returns valid Stripe checkout URL
Backend: POST /api/checkout/create-session with plan=pro_monthly returns valid Stripe checkout URL
Backend: POST /api/checkout/create-session with plan=pro_annual returns valid Stripe checkout URL
Backend: POST /api/checkout/create-session with plan=invalid_plan returns 400 error
Backend: Pro user (admin) trying to checkout gets 'already have Pro access' error
Backend: POST /api/webhook/stripe endpoint exists and returns 400 for invalid signature
Backend: POST /api/billing/portal-session returns 400 for free tier user
Frontend: Pricing page shows 3 cards (Free, Starter, Pro) with correct prices
Frontend: Monthly/Yearly toggle switches displayed prices correctly
Frontend: Clicking Start Starter initiates checkout (redirects to Stripe checkout.stripe.com)
Frontend: Dashboard shows Manage Subscription button for paid users only (verified: hidden for free, visible for pro)
critical_code_review_comments: Stripe integration uses real price IDs from environment variables (STRIPE_STARTER_MONTHLY_PRICE_ID, etc.)
Checkout endpoint correctly validates plan and blocks users who already have the target tier
Webhook handler properly verifies Stripe signature using STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
Billing portal correctly checks user tier before creating portal session
Frontend Pricing.jsx correctly maps plan names to checkout API (starter_monthly, starter_yearly, pro_monthly, pro_yearly)
Dashboard.jsx correctly shows Manage Subscription button only for starter/pro tiers
seed_data_creation: Used existing free test user: freetest@test.com
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 11 tested Stripe integration with real price IDs. All 4 subscription plans (starter_monthly $39.99, starter_annual $319.99, pro_monthly $79, pro_annual $632) create valid Stripe checkout sessions. Webhook at /api/webhook/stripe handles checkout.session.completed, customer.subscription.updated, customer.subscription.deleted, invoice.payment_failed (3-day grace), invoice.payment_succeeded. Billing portal at /api/billing/portal-session requires starter/pro tier. Frontend Pricing.jsx has 3-card layout with monthly/yearly toggle. Dashboard.jsx shows Manage Subscription button only for starter/pro users. Stripe is in test mode - do NOT complete payments.
